command: eda.duplicate_groups(train, subset); range checks; email and device tables
computed_on: train split only, dt < config.TRAIN_END_DT, guarded by assert_train_only

exact_rows.definition: identical on every column including TransactionID

same_content_same_time.definition: identical on every column except TransactionID

same_content.definition: identical on every column except TransactionID and TransactionDT

repeated_core_fields.definition: a different question from the three above: rows agreeing on the fields a person would call the same purchase, ignoring the counters and the V block that move every time. Card testing repeats the purchase, not the running totals, so a whole-row comparison cannot see it.

duplicates.note: repeated identical transactions are a known card testing shape. The number is recorded here and the decision on what to do about it is stage 3's.

agreement.definition: compared as raw strings, on rows where both are present

device_info.note: free text. The tail is what makes it free text: the count of distinct strings appearing once, against the share of rows they cover, is the size of the normalisation job stage 3 inherits.
